(grammar, X-bar theory) A type of entity in X-bar theory, denoting the preposition in a constructed sentence.
(chemistry) A set of elements in the periodic table having azimuthal quantum number 1.
(physics) A p-dimensional brane, where p is any whole number.
(programming) A very low-level code that is machine-independent and enables a compiled file to be run on different processor types.
Most implementations of the Pascal programming language employed a p-code system to achieve a greater level of machine independence.
(computing theory) Describing any problem in the complexity class P to which there exists a polynomial time mapping from any other problem in P.
(aviation) An aerodynamic phenomenon experienced by a moving propeller, whereby the propeller's center of thrust moves off-center when the aircraft is at a high angle of attack.

(music) A style of funk music associated with the Parliament-Funkadelic collective in the 1970s and early 1980s.
(medicine, cardiology) The time from the onset of the P wave to the first high-frequency component of the bundle of His electrogram, normally 119 ± 38 ms.
(sciences, statistics) The practice of reanalysis of data until a desired result is obtained which is statistically significant.
(organic chemistry) A chemical derivative of mexiletine with a hydroxy group in the para position. It is a metabolite of mexiletine.
(slang, often attributive) Sexual intercourse involving penile-vaginal penetration; vaginal sex.

(biology) A binding site for tRNA in the ribosome, activating after the A-site and before the E-site.
(informal) The prostate as a locus of sexual stimulation.
(physics) (Of a semiconductor) in which conduction is due to the movement of positive holes rather than electrons.
(statistics) In statistical significance testing, the probability of obtaining a test statistic at least as extreme as the one that was actually observed, assuming that the null hypothesis is true.
(geology, seismology) A longitudinal compressional wave produced by an earthquake.
(euphemistic) Any vulgar/taboo word starting with p, e.g. piss, penis, pussy, poof, prick, or Paki.
